lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered grid of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to gill slits, increasing in diameter and inter-centroid distance along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with large circular blobs, forming a repetitive matrix of high-contrast nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity upper edges and low-intensity lower shadows, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Medium-density distribution of high-luminance blobs within the first dorsal fin silhouette, with larger spots concentrated toward the base and smaller spots toward the distal edge.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small-diameter high-luminance spots on the dorsal surface of the primary pectoral fin.
